sourceReview: Selected output stream is use-closed before waitFor. Capped producer can observe closed read end rather than retain a full open pipe.
Owned started Process is destroyed in finally on ordinary output, input acquisition, read, close and wait failure. Missing command still degrades through existing error string.
Fixed public snapshot/logcat command arguments, 1..20000 line clamp, 256KiB/8KiB/4MiB caps, merged stderr and prefix UTF8 decoder unchanged.

No production hooks or test changes beyond the independently written test. No universal child execution deadline is introduced; a command that remains alive for reasons unrelated to its output pipe can still delay waitFor.

review.actionsPerformed: Read source/test/private fixture; wrote private review only. No Gradle after baseline, devices, network, real child processes or repository mutations.

limits: Native acceptance invokes actual APK private diagnostics exec with generated read-only child output in a separate shell process. HTTP transport/authentication, public logcat admission, actual oversized owner logs and all diagnostic commands were not exercised by that fixture.

The correction closes capped output before waiting and retires the created process. It does not add a universal command deadline or guarantee termination of unrelated long-lived/non-writing children or arbitrary process trees.

Native baselines did not finish within the 1.5-second protected wait and were observed at java.lang.UNIXProcess.waitFor. Identified generated cat children were terminated by the fixture so the real helper could return its exact prefix. These are bounded noncompletion observations, not arbitrary duration benchmarks.

JVM acquisition/read/close/wait failures use inert doubles. Native exception injection and external runner failure/timeout cleanup were not exercised; normal cleanup of four parents and sixteen generated children was verified.

Family Android10 generated-child helper behavior is verified; positive installed normal diagnostics separately pass in both rooms. API28, native UI and Living generated-child/visual acceptance remain unverified. Existing UI approvals and exhausted issue clocks retain their boundaries.
No Google phone operation, Home Assistant change, GitHub authentication, push or publication.
